newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee, sugar volume down in Feb, cocoa up.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee, sugar volume down in Feb, cocoa up.

text.p: LIFFE robusta coffee and white sugar futures volume fell in February month-on-month but cocoa and wheat showed an increase, the exchange said on Tuesday.
Coffee options volume also fell to 13,137 lots in February from 20,989 lots in January, cocoa slipped to a meagre 670 lots from 2,151 but white sugar options rose to 3,060 from 2,252 lots.

Cocoa volume reached 184,495 in February, up from 133,556 in January. But coffee turnover eased slightly to 154,553 lots from 186,720 in January, which saw the heights of a recent market rally on frenzied fund-led buying.
Turnover on the white sugar futures totalled 52,254 lots, down from January's 56,217 while wheat registered an increase to 12,691 from 8,925.
BIFFEX futures volume fell to 4,016 lots in February from 5,168 a month earlier.
